high_level_description: The image shows the exterior of an HDFC Bank branch. The bank's logo is prominently displayed on a blue signboard above the entrance. The signboard also advertises "Gold Loan Available Here," with images of gold rings to emphasize the service. In front of the bank, there are two individuals walking past the entrance. One person is wearing a purple checkered shirt, and the other is dressed in a light blue shirt. They appear to be in motion, possibly heading towards or away from the bank.
